title: Canonical identity scalar-extension unit
statement: Let $C$ be a category with objects in universe $u+1$, morphisms in universe $u$, essentially small in universe $u+1$, and let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology. For a commutative ring $R$ in universe $u+1$ and $\phi:R\to R$ with $\phi=\mathrm{id}$, use the actual restriction and its derived left adjoint of [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. Define normalizedOriginRestrictionUnit as identity maps on sections, using the scalar-restriction identity and the sheaf-to-presheaf fully faithful functor. Define normalizedOriginScalarUnit as its derived adjunction mate, an isomorphism from derived scalar extension along $\phi$ to the identity. It is the canonical tensor multiplication $x\otimes a\mapsto ax$, with no invertibility or boundedness assertion about other coefficient maps.
